tools.description: Layer 3 world slice at ref R: claims that HOLDAt(m,R) and/or code bytes at R — what was true at a specific commit, not just at HEAD. Requires git context; unanchored claims are excluded (strict); personal claims visible to their owner only. Code projection is the honest hybrid: HEAD embeddings restricted to paths in tree(R) with bodies replaced by git show bytes (no per-commit embedding corpus). Every hit carries as_of_ref and source_kind.

actor.description: Optional identity fallback when X-Ibis-Actor header is absent

ref.description: Full commit OID, branch, tag, or HEAD (required)

tools.name: as_of_project

tools.description: Hybrid agentic Q&A over HEAD file_chunk (current code), commit_chunk (change meaning), current team memory, and reasoning. Prefer why_changed for focused change forensics; prefer load_session_context/memory_search for durable team truth. Layer 3: pass at_ref (+ project_name) for the world slice at a commit — claims filtered by HOLDAt (status-current ignored at historical refs), changelog hits restricted to commits reachable from that ref, code bytes at ref via git show (HEAD-embedding hits outside tree(ref) are dropped). Claim store: without SurrealDB the at_ref slice degrades to git-native channels (claims from .ibis/claims/ at the ref — stubs title-only — and exact-path code) and the reply flags degraded:true.

at_ref.description: Optional full commit OID (or branch/tag) for the as_of world slice; skips HEAD agentic synthesis and returns structured HOLDAt-filtered hits

branch_or_commit.description: Optional current branch or commit to provide topological context to the AI

project_name.description: Required with at_ref: project scope for claim filtering and repo resolution

tools.name: ask_project

tools.description: Layer 3: structured delta of truths between two refs — claims added/removed via the ± HOLDAt symmetric difference (supersessions appear as old-removed + new-added, never phantom content_changed) plus the git path diff. Churn-capped: oversized results are truncated and flagged, never dumped unbounded.

actor.description: Optional identity fallback when X-Ibis-Actor header is absent

diff_mode.description: explicit (default: from_ref as given) | since_divergence (from_ref implicit: merge base of from_ref and to_ref — what changed on to's line since the branches diverged)

from_ref.description: Base ref (full OID, branch, tag, or HEAD) (required)

max_claims.description: Optional soft cap on total added+removed claims (default 200); overflow sets truncated=true

tools.description: Single aggregator for session start: working state + current (non-expired) rules + recent failures + top current team memories/decisions + active workstreams. Call ONCE per session for durable truth; use ask_project/why_changed for code and commit meaning.
tools.name: load_session_context

tools.description: Create a typed, temporally-aware memory (decision/fix/constraint/rule/gotcha/design/fact/observation/reasoning). Defaults to visibility=team. Pass source_hash (source_file content hash) and/or source_refs to source_file:* so git-driven RefreshStaleMemories can invalidate after HEAD ingest. Layer 3: pass introduced_in (full commit OID) or a commit:* source_ref to git-bind the claim; file-anchored claims follow anchor_mode (require_clean refuses dirty paths, worktree marks provenance.dirty, promote_on_commit binds on later commit).

actor.description: Optional identity fallback when X-Ibis-Actor header is absent

anchor_mode.description: Optional dirty-tree policy for file-anchored claims: require_clean | worktree (default) | promote_on_commit (flagged in provenance; promotion lands with the as_of phases)

branch.description: Optional git branch this memory applies to

embedding.description: Optional precomputed JSON float array embedding

introduced_in.description: Optional full commit OID this claim was introduced in (Layer 3 git binding; commit:* source_refs bind too)

source_hash.description: Optional provenance hash of linked source_file content (auto-resolved from source_file refs when omitted)

source_path.description: Optional canonical source path for path-based staleness (auto-resolved from source_file refs when omitted)

source_refs.description: Optional comma-separated record IDs this memory is derived_from

supersedes.description: Optional memory record ID this one replaces

tools.name: memory_add

tools.description: Claim store addendum §5: render existing durable claims (decision/rule/fix, visibility per personal-claims policy) into .ibis/claims/ and create ONE commit (chore(claims): bootstrap git claim store (N claims)). Idempotent: claims already in the tree are skipped; zero new files produce no commit. Pre-bootstrap honesty: git-owned claims get I(m) = bootstrap commit; earlier wall-clock history stays Surreal-only.

dry_run.description: Report the planned files without writing or committing

tools.name: memory_bootstrap_git_store

tools.description: Export memories as JSON or markdown from this runtime's SurrealDB. Defaults to visibility=team so other owners' personal rows are never exported. SurrealDB stays the source of truth; markdown also backs optional .ibis/memory projection.

actor.description: Optional identity for personal|all exports (trusted on loopback/stdio only)

tools.description: Claim store addendum §6: rebuild refs/notes/ibis-claims from the Surreal claim index — one `claim=<id>` pointer note per historical commit anchored to a git-owned claim (introduced_in/invalidated_at). Notes are cross-links enriching commit meaning: pointers only, never claim storage, never required for correctness, rebuildable from the DB. Idempotent reconcile: missing notes added, mismatched rewritten, stale notes removed; anchors absent from the object database are skipped and counted.
